description: Agile user story card — 'As a [persona], I want [action] so that [benefit]' with slotted content and state attributes

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: Level (1–6) of the Acceptance Criteria / Tasks / Notes headings. Default: one below the nearest preceding heading on the page (the slotted title is only shown in minimal mode, which has no sections).

attributes.name: persona-id
attributes.description: Links to a user-persona element by id. Without a persona slot, the "As a…" text uses that persona's job-title (live-updating; a legacy non-ARIA role attribute is also read).

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Story point estimate (badge reads "[n] story points" to screen readers)

attributes.name: story-id
attributes.description: Ticket or story identifier; sets the HTML id on first connect when none is set

attributes.name: detail
attributes.description: Detail level. minimal renders a button that opens the full story in a dialog.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON story record. Fetched once per value; a newer value aborts the older request.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Short label for minimal mode and the detail dialog heading (e.g., <h3>)

events.name: user-story:ready
events.detail: { id, persona, action, benefit, priority, status, points }
events.description: Once per element, after the first render. With src, after the fetched data renders (not fired if the fetch fails). Not re-fired by attribute changes or moves. For the 0.3.x line the deprecated un-namespaced alias story-ready is dispatched right after, with the same detail.

events.name: user-story:status-changed
events.description: Fired when updateStatus() is called with a known status. For the 0.3.x line the deprecated un-namespaced alias status-changed is dispatched right after, with the same detail.

events.name: user-story:priority-changed
events.description: Fired when updatePriority() is called with a known priority. For the 0.3.x line the deprecated un-namespaced alias priority-changed is dispatched right after, with the same detail.

events.name: user-story:upgraded
events.description: Once, in a microtask after first connect. Wait for this before assigning .data from a framework.
